жид.text:
From Old East Slavic жидъ (židŭ, “Jew”), from Proto-Slavic *židъ. Cognate with Polish Żyd (“Jew”).
The offensive connotation of the word is a 20th-century absorption from Russian. In Western Ukraine, євре́й (jevréj) is historically more pejorative than жид (see Khrushchev quote in the Russian entry).
